1) The Commercial Vehicles hired shall be for departmental use by South Central Railway, Se cunderabad on a Regular basis. The Vehicle will be used as per directions given by Dy.CSTE/P /Tele/SC for official Purpose for a period of 24 months. The base location shall be Hyderabad (T elangana). 2) EVALUATION CRITERION: The tenderer is required to upload the following mandatory docu ments along with the bid offer, failing by which the offer will be summarily rejected. a)AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Telangana for better coordination and service. DOCUMENTARY E VIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. b) DETAILS OF VEHICLE: One Vehicle (Non-AC SUV) should be registered in the name of Te nderer and should not sublet any part of the contract. However, the tenderer can have Lease Ag reement with the owner of the vehicle/cab aggregator on non-judicial stamp paper for the tenur e of the contract, which should be submitted along with the bid. The vehicle proposed to be offer ed on hire should be in good condition and not more than 4 years old, on the date of opening of tender. The tenderer is required to submit the COMMERCIAL VEHICLE REGISTRATION DETAILS al ong with supporting documents of the vehicle fulfilling the category, specifications along with th e tender, failing to submit the same along with the bid, the offer will be summarily rejected. Bids of other than commercial vehicles should be summarily rejected. Vehicle should be r egistered in the state of Telangana. If the bidder offers vehicl e registered in the state other than Telangana, then valid RT O permit of plying the vehicle in Telangana or ALL INDIA PER MIT to be mandatorily uploaded with the bid offer. Bids of commerc ial vehicles registered in any state other than Telangana state (without valid RTO permit of plyin g the vehicle in Telangana or ALL INDIA PERMIT) will be summarily rejected. c) PERFORMANCE DETAILS: Along with tender, bidders to enclose the list of ongoing vehicle h ire contracts with Railways, Other Central Government Departments, State Government and PS Us in the same city/location/agglomeration with details of Contract Period, rate per month, Vehic le Class, Model and brand, Fuel (Diesel/Petrol/ LPG/CNG/Electric/Hybrid), procurement cost (ex s howroom price) etc. Submission of this statement, even if Nil, shall be mandatory enclosure to t he tender failing which the offer will be summarily rejected. Annexure-III should be uploade d with the bid duly signed and stamped by the bidder failing which the offer will be s ummarily rejected without making any back reference. [Proforma as per document A nnexure-III of Buyer uploaded ATC document]. d) Submission of undertaking certifying the truthfulness of all the documents - The bidders shal l submit an undertaking certifying the truthfulness of all the documents submitted / uploaded al ong with the tender. This shall be mandatory for all the bidders. In case of failure of the bidder t o submit the undertaking, their offer shall be summarily rejected. Annexure-I should be uplo aded with the bid duly signed and stamped by the bidder failing which the offer will be summarily rejected without making any back reference. [Proforma as per Annexur e-I of Buyer uploaded ATC document]

e) Declaration of the details of the engagement of Retired/Existing Railway Employees. Declaration regarding site visit, compliance of statutory laws, penalty for violation of labor laws , Non blacklisting , termination of contracts etc. Self declaration of the undertaking by the bidde r that My/our firm/ Company is not under liquidation court receivership or similar proceedings a nd has not suffered bankruptcy/insolvency during the last 5 years. Annexure- IV should be up loaded with the bid duly signed and stamped by the bidder failing which the offer will be summarily rejected without making any back reference. [Proforma as per Ann exure-IV of Buyer uploaded ATC document]. f) CONSTITUTION OF FIRM: The bidder shall give full details of the constitution of the Firm/Co mpany/Society etc. and shall also submit following documents (as applicable), in addition to doc uments mentioned above. (i) Sole Proprietorship Firm: The bidder shall submit the notarized copy of the affidavit or GST certificate indicating Proprietorship certificate. (ii) Partnership Firm: The bidder shall submit self-attested copies of (i) registered/notariz ed Partnership Deed and (ii) Power of Attorney duly authorising one or more of the partn ers of the firm or any other persons(s), authorised by all the partners to act on behalf of t he firm and to submit & sign the Bid, sign the agreement, witness measurements, sign M easurement Books, receive payment, make correspondences, compromise/settle/ relinqu ish any claim (s) preferred by the firm, sign 'No Claim certificate', refer all or any dispute to arbitration and to take similar action in respect of all Bids/contracts OR said Bid/contract. (iii) Company registered under Companies Act-1956: The Bidder shall submit (i) the copie s of MOA (Memorandum of Association) and AOA (Articles of Association) of the Compan y; and (ii) Power of Attorney duly registered/notarized by the company (backed by the re solution of Board of Directors) in favour of the individual, signing the Bid on behalf of the Company. (iv) Society: The bidder shall submit (i) Self- attested copy of the certificate of Registratio n, (ii) Deed of Formation and (iii) Power of Attorney in favour of the tender signatory. (v) Joint Venture (JV): Joint Venture ( JV) not permitted /not allowed in this tender Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document. 3) The contractor/agency participating in the tender should normally be GST compliant regardin g registration, filing of returns etc., and shall be fully responsible for the compliance as per GST Act at all times. If the Contractor falls either “below the turnover threshold for GST” or is a “Com position Taxable Person” under the CGST Act, a self-declaration should be enclosed with his offe r duly supported by a certificate of turnover from a Chartered Accountant or enclose Form ‘REG- 06’ showing as “Composition” under Type of Registration and no GST is applicable for contracts with such persons/firms. GST for vehicle rental/hire services falls under SAC code 9966, as per w hich, the present applicable rate is 5% (2.5% CGST+2.5% SGST) for vehicles designed to carry men and materials where cost of fuel is included in the rate. 4) Once the contract is awarded, the service provider needs to submit Driver’s details to the con signee and driver should have passed a minimum of 10th standard and possess a valid driving li cence, Aadhar Card on his name and employee identification card issued by the Contractor at al l times. The verification of driver details, Driving license, Aadhar Card etc.. has to be done by co nsignee. 5) The vehicle’s should be available on all days including holidays as per requirement of the user for official duty. 6) In reference to SLA clause no.5.11 and 5.12, the substitute vehicle’s offered shall not be older than the vehicle under breakdown at any point of time during the currency of contract. The cond ition and upkeep of substitute vehicle shall be same as that of approved vehicle’s in the contract. 7) The contractor shall be responsible for providing the vehicles at any point of time in day or nig ht, even at short notice during any urgency/emergency. Hiring for 12 hours in a day means cont inuous hiring for 12 hours during day or 12 hours during night. No advance payment shall be ma de and all payments released on completion of stipulated service periodically/monthly as stipula ted. In case, on any day, the vehicle was utilised for more than 12 hours on exceptional/ emerge ncy requirement, relaxation to that extent may be provided in subsequent days to the Contracto r/firm. 8) Imposition of penalties is as per Para 8 of GeM SLA. 9) The SLA clause 4.2 sub clause (1) & (2) for payment of extra kilo meter and extra hours shall not be applicable to this contract. In any month, vehicle run can be more or less than the scale o f Number of 2000KM/month but shall not exceed cumulative KM 24,000 per year for SUV A/C an d Sedan Non A/C vehicles and for SUV non A/C vehicle the scale of Number of 2500KM/month bu t shall not exceed cumulative KM 30,000 per year. Payment will be made on a monthly basis as per accepted monthly rate irrespective of actual KM run in that month. No further variation in K M is either allowed or to be paid. The rate quoted shall be inclusive of salary of driver, daily batt a, fuel, petrol/diesel, other consumables, regular maintenance, expenses and other expenditure towards repairs, taxes etc. 10) Price variation Clause is not applicable in this tender.

11) A Log Book for each vehicle shall be maintained by the Contractor for the hired vehicles. The KM utilised shall be entered in it on a daily basis to ensure proper account and payment at the e nd of every month/specified period. It is the responsibility of the official using the vehicle to kee p the log book up to date and the vehicle is used for the official duties/works. Statement of entri es as per Log Book should be enclosed with the bills submitted for payment by the service provi der/contractor duly counter signed by the official to who/under whose custody the vehicle is plac ed except that in case of vehicles hired for DRMs/PHODs/AGM/GM, this statement shall be count ersigned by nominated officer in the secretariat. In case of pooled vehicles, Secretary to PHOD o r ADRM or nominated in charge Gazetted Officer will sign the Log Book/statement sent with bills thereof, as the case may be. 12) The vehicle contract can be short-closed with three months notice, if the post of the officer i s surrendered or the officer opts for drawl of transport allowance or any other administrative rea son (except unsatisfactory service, which will be as per penalty clause of SLA). In this regard, th e following conditions will be applicable: The Railway has liberty to short-close the contract with any or all of the service providers normal ly with three months' notice without assigning any reason. However, in case a service provider wants to short close his services, he will have to serve 4 months advance written notice. a. The contract for the vehicles hired can also be terminated with a short notice of 15 days on account of unsatisfactory services at the discretion of the Officer in charge of hiring of vehicl es. The unsatisfactory service shall mean and include the non-compliance of any of the obligatio ns by the service provider, as given in this agreement and/or under the penalty clauses of the S LA of GeM contract or repeated breach. PG of the service provider will be forfeited in the case of breach of SLA where the breach is not capable of remedy and the contract is terminated. b. In case of any dispute of any kind, the Contractor/ Agency shall abide by the decision of t he controlling authority or Nodal Officer or Buyer in charge of hiring of the vehicle as the case m ay be. 13) Successful Bidders have to submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Re ceipt /Performance bank Guarantee (Bank Guarantee sample format as per Annexure-II of scope of work document). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of PFA/SC (Name of the Service Provider). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with a covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the buyer within 30 days of award of bid in GeM/date of issue of intimation to deposit Performan ce Security. GeM contract will be issued only after receipt of Performance Security. Extension of time for submission of PG beyond 30 days and up to the date of submission of PG from the date of issue of intimation to deposit Performance Security may be given by Dy.CMM/G However, a pe nal interest of 15% per annum shall be charged for the delay beyond 30 days (i.e from 31st day after the date of issue of intimation to deposit Performance Security. In case the contractor fails to submit the requisite PG after 60 days from the date of issue of intimation to deposit Performa nce Security, a notice shall be served to the contractor to deposit PG immediately however not e xceeding 90 days from date of intimation. In case the contractor fails to submit the requisite PG even after 90 days from the date of intimation, a notice shall be served to the contractor and th e GeM Bid shall be cancelled duly forfeiting EMD and other dues, if any payable against the ten der. The failed Service Provider shall be debarred from participating in re-tender for that service. In case, 60th day is a bank holiday or office closure next working day should be considered as th e last day for submission of PGs, Decision of Dy.CMM/G would be final in case of any dispute.

14) (a) The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior writte n consent of buyer (b) The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of the buyer. (c) The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly an d severally liable and responsible to the buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for an d in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 15) The Service provider having non-satisfactory/bad performance in previously completed cont racts or current live contracts may be rejected. 16) The vehicle documents which were uploaded in the bidding process should be kept in servic e along with the Number, Model and type of vehicle’s after approval of consignee. In case ,the c ondition of vehicle’s is not satisfactory or require replacement due to any other reason , service provider has to replace the vehicle’s with same segment or higher segment commercial vehicle’ s, mentioned in GeM SLA, as per bid conditions with approval of user/consignee. 17) The vehicle’s should be available every day at nominated time and place as per the directio ns of Dy.CSTE/P/Tele/SC given from time to time. Vehicles shall/Can be parked in the Railway premises/Residence during night time for emergency use as per direction of Dy.CSTE/P/Tele/S C the Vehicle keys should be submitted to the officer/authorize representative after duty hours, i n case any emergency officer can use the vehicle. Minimum 30% of fuel tank capacity should be in the vehicle all the time. In case of any dispute, the decision of Dy.CMM/G shall be binding reg arding placement and usage of vehicle for contractor. 18) The bills will be submitted through the GeM Portal by Seller. The Seller has to prepare a draft Seller Invoice and submit it to the Consignee for verification and levy of penalty, if any. After verification of Co nsignee, Seller shall generate final Seller invoice with penalty (if any) and upload/attach copy of Log Boo k, Penalty advice from Consignee, Fund certification from Consignee etc with final Seller invoice and fina lly generate GeM Seller Invoice. The Consignee shall ensure generation of Service Delivery Acceptance Certificate (SDAC) and verify the penalty etc, if any. If the invoice generated by Seller, mismatches with contract/ the amount of penalty imposed / document stated above, the Consignee shall return the Seller GeM invoice in GeM itself suggesting the corrections. If the Seller GeM invoice and Seller Invoice is corre ct, then, SDAC shall be generated within 7 working days from the date of GeM seller invoice date, else G eM will auto-generate SDAC and populate the bill to Buyer for forwarding to Paying authority. The Bill Pa ssing officer is Consignee indicated in the contract and the Bill Paying Officer is PFA/SCR. 19) Periodical Inspection: The Consignee shall periodically inspect the vehi cle in accordance with the applicable CVC guidelines before passing/forwardin g the monthly bills for payment. The details of the vehicle shall be verified wit h reference to the Technical Specifications offered by the bidder and the infor mation/documents available under the 'Seller Documents' section of the GeM Contract. . 3.
